entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I need to return something. This VeloBand Cadence Sensor. The whole process is just so confusing, I'm not sure if I'm even allowed to anymore.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band or more of a preference?

Oh, I don't know. It's not broken, it just... isn't for me. I actually tried to do this online last week, on my 9th day, but I think there was a huge website error. The whole system seemed to be down.
I'm very sorry to hear you experienced trouble with our website. Let me check the system logs for that period. One moment.
Yeah, I just kept getting a weird message. I took a screenshot of it because nothing was working. I couldn't print a label or anything. It was just stuck. Can't you just help me?

Yes, I can absolutely help you. And thank you for that information. I do see a notification that our returns portal had a brief, known outage last week. I sincerely apologize for that inconvenience. Let me just confirm the policy for you.

Okay, I've pulled up your order. I see it was delivered 15 days ago. According to our policy, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. So, you are still well within the timeframe.
Wait, 90 days? Really? Oh, thank goodness. I was so overwhelmed thinking I had missed my chance because of that error. That's a huge relief. So I can definitely send it back?

Absolutely. The website issue was definitely our fault, but you're well inside the 90-day window anyway. I have just manually generated a return authorization for you. I'm sending the pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file. Do you see it?
Let me check... yes! It's here! Thank you so much, Sarah. You've made this so much easier.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
